description: React component for an admin dashboard with security, SCIM, and UI settings, including SSO configuration, IP whitelisting, and admin management.

classes.name: AdminPanel
classes.description: React functional component for admin dashboard with security and user management features.

methods.name: checkSSOConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches and updates SSO configuration status.

methods.name: handleShowAllowedIPs
methods.description: Fetches and displays allowed IP addresses, with premium user check.

methods.name: handleAddIP
methods.description: Adds a new IP address to allowed list.

methods.name: handleDeleteIP
methods.description: Prepares to delete an IP address.

methods.name: confirmDeleteIP
methods.description: Confirms and executes IP address deletion.

methods.name: handleAddSSOOk
methods.description: Handles successful SSO addition and refreshes status.

methods.name: handleShowInstructions
methods.description: Shows instructions modal for SSO setup.

methods.name: handleInstructionsOk
methods.description: Handles closing instructions modal and refreshes SSO status.

methods.name: handleInstructionsCancel
methods.description: Cancels instructions modal and refreshes SSO status.

methods.name: fetchProxyAdminInfo
methods.description: Fetches proxy admin and viewer user info.

methods.name: handleMemberCreate
methods.description: Creates a new member and sends invitation.

methods.name: handleAdminCreate
methods.description: Creates a new admin and sends invitation.
